messages.subject: Problem transferring code from JAGS
parts:
I have a BUGS-code running in JAGS and I want to transfer it to NIMBLE to compare performance. However, I get the following error message when attempting to run the nimbleModel command: 
Error in indexRangeCode[[1]] : object of type 'symbol' is not subsettable
Is the issue that I have indices not looping with increments of 1? For instance, in the code (below), Lans is

Grateful for any pointers on how to modify the code to fit with the NIMBLE dialect. 

The code looks as following:

NegBinHuntCode<- nimbleCode({
 
    for (r in 1:Reports){
      
      # Number of killed animals in report r is negative binomial distributed,
      # but defined from the mean (m[KretsNr[r]]*A[r]) and coefficient of variation (c[Lan[r]]) of the gamma distribution of the equivalent gamma-poisson mixture
      K[r] ~ dnegbin(1/(1+m[KretsNr[r]]*A[r]*c[Lan[r]]^2),c[Lan[r]]^-2) 
    }
    
    for (k in Kretsar){
      
      m[k] <- exp(logL[KretsListLan[k]]+logK[k]) #m[k] is the mean killing rate per area in circuit k
      
      logK[k] ~ dnorm(0,kretsprec[KretsListLan[k]]) # logK[k] is the circuit random effect of circuit k
      
      SamplePoiss[k] ~ dpois(m[k]*UnreportedAperkrets[k]) #  samples how much was killed on the unreported area of circuit k, assuming a Poisson process
   
    }
    for (l in Lans){
      logL[l] ~ dnorm(logS,lansprec) # logL[l] is the county level random effect of county L
      kretsprec[l] ~ dgamma(kretsprecalpha,kretsprecalpha/kretsprecmean) # kretsprec[l]  is the precision parameter for the hierarchical distribution of circuit effects with county l
      
      c[l] <- exp(logcmean+logckrets[l]) # c[l] is the coefficient of variation as above
      logckrets[l] ~ dnorm(0,logcprec) # county level effect for c
      
    }
    logS ~ dnorm(0,.001) 
    logcmean ~ dnorm(0,.01) 
    logcprec ~ dgamma(.01,.01)
    kretsprecalpha ~ dgamma(.01,.01)
    kretsprecmean  ~ dgamma(.01,.01)
    lansprec ~ dgamma(.01,.01)
    
 
  
  
})



Constants <- list(A=A,Reports=Reports,KretsNr=KretsNr,Kretsar=Kretsar,KretsListLan=KretsListLan,Lan=Lan,Lans=Lans,UnreportedAperkrets=UnreportedAperkrets)
Data <- list(K=K)
Inits <- list(c=rep(1,length(Lans)),logL=rep(7,length(Lans)),logK=rep(0,length(Kretsar)),logcmean=0,logckrets=rep(0,length(Lans)),kretsprec=rep(1,length(Lans)),logS=7,logcprec=1,kretsprecalpha=1,kretsprecmean=1,lansprec=1)

Hunting <- nimbleModel(code = NegBinHuntCode, name = "hunt", constants = Constants,
                    data = Data, inits = Inits)

messages.subject: Re: Problem transferring code from JAGS
parts:
Yes, I think that is the issue.

Please try replacing "for(k in kretsar)" with "for(ik in 1:length(kretsar))" and "k" with "kretsar[ik]".  And try a similar modification to the Lans section.

Let us know further questions.

messages.author: f40a5ae36440ef7e
messages.subject: Re: Problem transferring code from JAGS
parts: Thank you very much pdevalpine for your very quick response! It got me some of the way, but I still couldn't get it to work, I think because of issues of assigning initial values to parameters that didn't have sequential indices. So I re-wrote the code to only use sequential indices by reshuffling the indices of the data. A bit more bookkeeping to keep track of the two types of indices, but now the MCMC works. And pretty damn quick, I must say!
